_comment: Curated role profiles for SkillGraph. All market_evidence fields contain a disclaimer. Not derived from live job postings.

backend-engineer.description: Designs, builds, and maintains server-side systems, APIs, and data pipelines that power web and mobile applications.
responsibilities: Design and implement RESTful and gRPC APIs
Build and optimise relational and NoSQL database schemas
Implement authentication, authorisation, and security controls
Write automated tests and maintain CI/CD pipelines
Monitor service health and respond to incidents
Collaborate with frontend engineers and product stakeholders
example_projects: Build a REST API for a task-tracking application with JWT authentication
Implement a rate-limited API gateway with Redis caching
Design a multi-tenant PostgreSQL schema with row-level security
backend-engineer.market_evidence: Curated profile based on publicly observed job descriptions. Not derived from live job postings or statistical analysis. Individual employer requirements may vary significantly.

machine-learning-engineer.description: Bridges research and production by training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models at scale.
responsibilities: Train, evaluate, and iterate on ML models
Build feature engineering pipelines
Deploy models to production via REST or gRPC endpoints
Monitor model drift and retrain on new data
Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineers
Maintain experiment tracking and model registry
example_projects: Train and deploy a text classification model with MLflow experiment tracking
Build an end-to-end feature pipeline with Airflow and a feature store
Implement model monitoring with drift detection and alerting
